The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerkâ€™s office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Planning Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the Community Development Department (temporary facility) at 1225 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
The Planning Commission will listen to the public on any action item on the agenda or any item that is not on the agenda but relevant to City business. The Planning Commission cannot legally take action on any item not scheduled on the agenda. Such items may be referred for administrative action or scheduled on a future agenda. If you wish to speak to the Planning Commission, please complete a Speaker's Card and present it before the agenda item is called. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak to the Planning Commission. Should you need to provide written documentation to the City, please give the Principal Planner a minimum of TEN (10) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed appropriately. Comments will generally be limited to three minutes per speaker. However, a shorter limit may be declared by the Chairperson for agenda items for which many Speaker Cards have been submitted.
Public Comment For Items On The Agenda: Speakers will be called on in the order cards were received.
Public Comment For Items Not On The Agenda: Persons wishing to speak on agenda items will be called at the time the agenda item is brought forward.
